title: Political Alpha: FEC API + SEC Form 4 + Executive Orders as Live Data Sources
rotation: A — WebSearch FEC filings, SEC insider trades, executive orders
context: PA1-PA3 stuck at Brier=0.3 with 0-2 feature candidates. 5-patch fix deployed to GitHub awaiting VM deployment. This proposal adds 3 new live data sources to ops/fetch_political_data.py to enrich the event feed and unlock feature diversity.

data_sources.name: FEC OpenFEC API
data_sources.data: Individual contributions, PAC filings, donor amounts, filing dates
data_sources.update_frequency: 48h lag for electronic filings, weeks for paper
data_sources.feature_impact: Enables Cat1 DONOR PROFILE features (200 features) — currently starved of data
data_sources.integration: Add fetch_fec_donations(ticker_map) to ops/fetch_political_data.py, match employers to tickers

data_sources.name: SEC EDGAR Form 4 (Insider Trading)
data_sources.data: Insider buy/sell transactions, Form 4 filings, officer/director names
data_sources.feature_impact: Enables Cat6 INSIDER TRADING features (150 features) — currently broken due to FIX3 field mismatch
data_sources.integration: Replace current insider data source with EDGAR direct feed, fix 'side' vs 'type' field via 5-patch FIX3

data_sources.name: Federal Register Executive Orders
data_sources.data: Executive orders, proclamations, affected agency codes, signing dates
data_sources.feature_impact: Enables Cat2 POLICY SIGNAL features (300 features) — sector/ticker affected by EO
data_sources.integration: Map agency codes to sectors/tickers via existing SECTOR_TO_TICKERS dict in political_engine.py

data_sources.name: Polymarket API (existing, field fix needed)
data_sources.data: Political prediction market probabilities, volumes, whale activity
data_sources.feature_impact: Enables Cat5 POLYMARKET SIGNALS (150 features) — currently broken due to price vs probability field name
data_sources.integration: Already covered by FIX4 in apply_patches.py — deploy 5-patch fix

implementation_priority: STEP 1: Deploy 5-patch fix from hf-space/apply_patches.py (BLOCKING — currently 0 features)
STEP 2: Add fetch_fec_donations() to ops/fetch_political_data.py using api.open.fec.gov (no API key needed for DEMO_KEY, 1000 req/day)
STEP 3: Add fetch_sec_form4() using EDGAR EFTS search API (no auth required)
STEP 4: Add fetch_executive_orders() using Federal Register API (no auth required)
STEP 5: Run ops/fetch_political_data.py on VM cron (already scheduled per CLAUDE.md)
cross_repo_port: FEC donor data can enrich NBA prediction via sponsor analysis of arenas; low priority cross-port
